facts.statement: ClearTill calculates from the balance, dates and costs entered by the user.
ClearTill does not require a bank login or Open Banking connection.
ClearTill shows a forward position after allowing for entered bills and costs due before the next income date.
The free live preview lasts seven days.
The preview starts only after the user saves a complete position containing a balance, payday and at least one upcoming cost.
The free live preview requires no card and does not charge automatically when it ends.
After the preview expires, live updates and reminders stop and the last position remains read-only.
Paid plans provide ongoing live positions, carry recurring costs forward and provide ongoing reminders.
The public monthly plan is £3.99 per month.
The public annual plan is £24.99 paid upfront per year.
Account controls allow the user to export, reset or delete their data.

conditionalFacts.statement: A separate £1.99 card-based subscription-trial flow exists behind SUBSCRIPTION_TRIAL_ENABLED.
conditionalFacts.marketingUse: Do not advertise while the public no-card preview is the active offer.
